sentences.en: The laterality of the brain can affect how people process information.
sentences.zh: 大脑的偏侧性会影响人们处理信息的方式。

sentences.en: Some athletes have a distinct laterality, favoring one hand over the other in their sport.
sentences.zh: 一些运动员在运动中明显偏向使用一只手。

sentences.en: Laterality is often discussed when studying handedness and its effects on daily activities.
sentences.zh: 研究用手习惯及其对日常生活的影响时常会提到偏侧性。

senses.zh: 对一侧面的偏重， 偏向一侧状态
